source_description_claim: AI-driven development agent that can inspect code, edit files and run commands.

source_description_claim: Open-source coding agent and assistant for IDE, terminal and CI.

source_description_claim: Open omni-channel support desk spanning chat, email and messaging.
notes: Good future donor if owner-facing support traffic justifies a dedicated inbox.

source_description_claim: Self-hosted newsletter and mailing-list manager.
